(define L (list 'a 'b 'c))
(car L)                      ; a          -- the first element
(cdr L)                      ; (b c)      -- everything after the first
(cons 'z L)                  ; (z a b c)  -- a new list with z on the front
(null? '())                  ; #t         -- true for the empty list
(pair? L)                    ; #t         -- true for a nonempty list
